name: io.github.Servosity/tactical-rmm-mcp
title: Tactical RMM MCP
description: Every Tactical RMM endpoint as a typed command, plus an offline SQLite mirror and cross-entity

environmentVariables.name: TACTICAL_RMM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Tactical RMM API host, e.g. https://api.rmm.example.com. It is the api.* hostname from your Tactical RMM install, not the web UI hostname. The shipped default points at an example host.

environmentVariables.name: TRMM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the TRMM_API_KEY credential for the Tactical RMM MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: TACTICAL_RMM_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call.

environmentVariables.name: TACTICAL_RMM_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off.

environmentVariables.name: TACTICAL_RMM_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Tactical RMM requests.

environmentVariables.name: TACTICAL_RMM_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: binds the MCP server to an existing tenant-gated Printing Press client profile. Leave unset for a single-tenant install.
